rationale: C18 plausibly supplied a material drafting template because it uses numbered operative provisions to alter the territorial organization of federal collection districts, including defining district or port limits by geographic boundaries, followed by a delayed-effective-date clause. The child applies substantially the same machinery to internal-revenue collection districts by transferring specified territory between districts. C22 is a close but less extensive customs-field analogue, while C03 shares the transfer-and-effective-date sequence but concerns consolidation of land offices rather than territorial collection boundaries.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The territory known as the Country of Richmond (Staten Island), now comprising a part of the first internal revenue collection district of New York, is transferred to and made a part of the second internal revenue collection district of New York.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The limits of the customs port of entry of Alexandria Bay, New York, in Customs Collection District Number 7 (St. Lawrence), are extended to include the Township of Alexandria...
shared_material.explanation: Both provisions reassign or enlarge the territorial coverage of a federal collection unit by identifying the affected locality and its existing or receiving district.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following-described territory... is transferred to and made a part of the second internal revenue collection district of New York: Beginning at a point... thence northerly... thence easterly... thence southerly...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The limits of the customs port of entry of Mobile, Alabama... are extended to include that portion of Blakeley Island lying south of the Cochrane Bridge Causeway; Pinto Island; and the area comprising the Brookley Air Field.
shared_material.explanation: Both use concrete geographic descriptions within numbered provisions to redraw administrative collection boundaries.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall become effective on January 1, 1951.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall become effective on the thirtieth day following the date hereof.
shared_material.explanation: Each concludes the collection-boundary changes with an express prospective effective-date provision.
